1. Chat Simulator, hereafter referred to as this application, is just intended to have fun with your friends. You can use it to craft fake ingoing and outgoing messages, so you can then show them to other people. It does not, by any means, try to replace any original and genuine Chat App application.

 2. This application does not send or receive real messages to anybody. All you see is happening inside your smartphone device, and no messages will be sent to your contacts.

 3. By using this application, you accept the terms above. Have fun!
